audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit was named as the tracked cooldown with no number and no statement of what it does. 'Dodging this is the whole matchup' does not tell a player why, or what happens if they eat it.
audit.why: Riot's E text: the spirit echoes a percentage of the damage it takes back to the original target, and if the spirit is killed or the target walks too far from it, the target becomes a Vessel and starts spawning tentacles. It is 16/15/14/13/12s, so a dodged E is a real 16-second window at rank 1.
audit.corrected: The 16s number, the damage echo and the Vessel condition written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], dontsFull[1] and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the packet and with their own whys: Level 1 read Skill while whys[0] says you concede nothing, Level 2 read Illaoi while whys[1] calls it 'a genuine coin-flip skill check', Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read Skill while whys[3] and whys[4] both describe her owning those windows, and 2+ items read Illaoi while whys[6] says it evens out.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill; the mirror already moved Level 1 to Kled and Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Illaoi on both layers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs onto that chart, ratings moved with them, and the four generic phases whys rewritten so the prose states the real reason for each side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer wrote 'Beartrap' and referred to Illaoi as 'he' and 'him' in five places. Harsh Lesson was never named anywhere, and it is both her gap-closer and an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell that the tentacle swing is coming.
audit.why: Riot's W text: Illaoi leaps to her target, dealing damage and causing nearby Tentacles to also swing at that target, on a 4s cooldown with an autoReset flag. Her passive heals her whenever a tentacle damages a champion, which is what makes lingering in the field lose.
audit.corrected: Name and pronouns fixed, Harsh Lesson's 4s leap named as the reset tell in the cooldown block and wants.foe[1], and the tentacle heal written into the don'ts and itemization.

edits.before: Beartrap Illaoi when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope Illaoi outside her tentacle field, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage.

notes: The missing-interactions file will keep suggesting that Leap of Faith grounds Kled's Jousting and Chaaaaaaaaarge!!!. That comes from a 'grounding' derived flag on Illaoi's kit file, but Riot's Leap of Faith text describes only damage and a tentacle per champion hit — no grounding at all. Per the description-over-flag rule I made no grounding claim anywhere, matching what the mirror auditor did from Illaoi's side; the bad flag is in champ-data/_kits/illaoi.json and will mislead every future agent on this matchup. Also note the brief reports games 531 at the top level but 352 inside the packet.
